close_reason: OnceLock removed from LazyLock — comment confirms single execution guarantee
description: relay_client.rs lines 365-382: TLS_CLIENT_CONFIG is a LazyLock whose initializer closure contains a static OnceLock to guard install_default(). LazyLock already guarantees its closure runs exactly once, so the inner OnceLock adds zero synchronization protection and only adds a dead static allocation and reader confusion. The OnceLock should be removed; install_default() already returns Err if called twice, so the if-let guard alone is sufficient.
title: TLS_CLIENT_CONFIG: OnceLock inside LazyLock is redundant
